title: i love paddington!!!!!!! #musicals #newmusicals #paddingtonbear #padd...
transcript: The past few days, this poster has been popping up all around New York City. Have you seen this bear? Look at him! And don't worry, friends, we have found him. And it's at the Al Hirschfeld. Cause Paddington is coming to Broadway! I love Paddington. I love all the movies, I love his cutie little jacket. But I know not a thing about this musical. Like, nothing about it. Minus the fact that everyone I know who's seen it has said it's like their favorite musical they've seen ever. So I am so excited that it's coming to New York, but the little video they released made me cry. So I feel like I'm going to be a mess watching this show. I haven't listened to any of the music either, cause I wanna go in, like, knowing as little as possible. So I'm just. I'm very excited. New York, please look out for this bear now. It's not coming until spring 2027. First preview is March 30th. Opening night is April 18th. We know it's going to be a heavy, heavy, heavy Tony favorite in the race of next year. I'll definitely be in London before it opens on Broadway. So will I see it then? Maybe. Maybe I will. But I also just can't wait to see it in New York. And yes, I did make my friends steal this poster for me because I want to frame it. Welcome to Broadway, Paddington. I promise we'll take good care of your bear. London.
